#Dogecoin folks when you see a small trade at a fraction off the price, it’s just a market order that couldn’t be 100% filled at the same price-point. It’s called “slippage”.. it’s not a “paint the tape” or “spoofing.” This is not how you would manipulate a market.

#Dogecoin there is absolutely no way to know if a buy or sell is associated with short trading. The tape can give indications... but from trade to trade it can’t be determined by anyone but parties involved in the transaction.

#Dogecoin folks there is a difference  between the bid & ask price. So when the ticker shows a higher and lower price, it’s NOT because of “shorts”... it’s because the market maker makes a commission.
